summary: One-frame result of item combination (crafting), filled in esv::combine::ExecutionSystem::FinalizeComponents (bg3.exe+0x2F28BA0, Toolkit-matched) from the system's per-entity sets of 24-byte result records. On Windows the component is a hash set of 24-byte records (16 bytes hashed as lo ^ hi like a Guid, plus two bytes compared). Written out because a struct may not be a HashSet key in this format: the HashSet's three parts are declared explicitly (same memory as SE HashSet<T>: StaticArray<int32> HashKeys, Array<int32> NextIds, Array<T> Keys). Saved: model game.combine.v0.ResultOneFrameComponent (48 bytes) with the game's member names m_ResultEntities, m_BaseNotFounds, m_IngredientNotFounds - these do NOT map one-to-one onto the Windows component (which is one set), so they are not used as field names. Never seen alive. Registry total 48 (server row).

fields.name: ResultEntity
fields.evidence: Hash insert bg3.exe+0xBDD320 hashes `(param_3[1] ^ *param_3) % buckets` (the LS Guid hash) and the find bg3.exe+0xC662A0 compares qwords +0 and +8 - a 16-byte value, Guid by its hash; meaning not established. Name: savegame model game.combine.v0.ResultOneFrameComponent, member 0 (m_ResultEntities, an array of 16-byte values): the Windows save writer bg3.exe+0x2606770 walks the component's records at +0x20 (count +0x2C, stride 0x18 = `puVar21 + 6` dwords) and copies the first 16 bytes of each into that array.

fields.name: BaseNotFound
fields.evidence: find bg3.exe+0xC662A0 compares `(char)` at +0x10. Name and type: bg3.exe+0x2606770 stores `*(char*)(record + 0x10) != 0` as a bool into the second model array - savegame model member 1 (m_BaseNotFounds).

fields.name: IngredientNotFound
fields.evidence: find bg3.exe+0xC662A0 compares the byte at +0x11. Name and type: bg3.exe+0x2606770 stores `*(char*)(record + 0x11) != 0` as a bool into the third model array - savegame model member 2 (m_IngredientNotFounds).

fields.name: _Pad12
fields.evidence: padding to the stride 0x18 (insert writes `iVar9 * 0x18`, copies 16 bytes + one qword at +0x10).

fields.name: HashKeys
fields.evidence: HashSet bucket table (int32 per bucket): insert bg3.exe+0xBDD320 / find bg3.exe+0xC662A0 read `*param_1 + bucket * 4`.

fields.name: HashKeysSize
fields.evidence: bucket count `(int)param_1[1]` used as the modulus in bg3.exe+0xBDD320.

fields.name: NextIds
fields.evidence: `param_1[2] + idx * 4` chain links in the find; capacity param_1[3], size +0x1C grown in the insert.

fields.name: ResultEntities
fields.evidence: keys at param_1[4] with stride 0x18, capacity param_1[5], size +0x2C (insert bg3.exe+0xBDD320). Creator bg3.exe+0x2F29900 (AllocRaw 0x30) zeroes +0..+0x2F; destructor thunk of bg3.exe+0x582AD0 frees +0x20, +0x10, +0 (trivially destructible records). FinalizeComponents lines 45-62 insert every 0x18-byte element of the system's sets. Game name: member 0 (m_ResultEntities) of savegame model ls::model::game::combine::v0::ResultOneFrameComponent; matched by the macOS Save (bg3_macos_x64+0x517E8C0): it walks the array at component +0x20 (count +0x2C, stride 0x18) and copies the first 16 bytes of each element into model member 0; the model is flatter than the component (a span instead of this hash table). Windows save writer bg3.exe+0x2606770 confirms the same walk (+0x20, count +0x2C, stride 0x18).

open_questions: The 16-byte ResultEntity is hashed like a Guid (lo ^ hi); whether it is a Guid or an entity's UUID is not distinguishable from the code (16 bytes either way).
The hash table is written as its four parts because a struct may not be a HashSet key in this format (same memory as HashSet<CombineResultRecord>).

names_pass: Matched 1 of 3: ResultEntities = the keys array at +0x20 (the whole 48-byte hash structure is that member; only its key array row was renamed). Not matched: m_BaseNotFounds and m_IngredientNotFounds - the macOS Save writes them as empty spans, nothing of the component goes there; the two bytes +0x10/+0x11 of each record are not saved. HashKeys/HashKeysSize/NextIds are hash-table internals, not model members.
second_pass: Record members named and typed from the Windows save writer bg3.exe+0x2606770, which flattens each 24-byte record into the three arrays of savegame model game.combine.v0.ResultOneFrameComponent (16-byte ResultEntities, bool BaseNotFounds from +0x10, bool IngredientNotFounds from +0x11); the hash-table offsets were already Windows.
